one_line: Persian master painters leading Akbar’s vast Hamzanama workshop in Agra and Fatehpur Sikri.

appearance.age_look: Both look in their late 30s to early 40s, lean but sturdy, with the poise of seasoned court artists who work long hours.
appearance.face: Mir Sayyid Ali has an oval face, light wheat-brown complexion, fine straight nose, trimmed pointed beard and moustache, arched brows and calm, observant eyes with a gentle, thoughtful default expression; Abdus Samad has a slightly squarer jaw, similar light brown complexion, fuller neatly trimmed beard, slightly heavier brows and a focused, slightly intense default expression, as if assessing a painting.
appearance.hair: Both keep dark brown to black hair cropped short and mostly hidden under small white Mughal Persian-style caps (tall, rounded soft caps) wrapped with narrow light-cream turbans; a little hairline is visible at the temples, with no loose strands.
appearance.costume: Each wears a long, knee-length, side-tied jama in fine cotton: Mir Sayyid Ali’s jama is pale sky blue with very fine, closely spaced white vertical stripes and a subtle floral block-print border at the hem and cuffs, belted at the waist with a narrow woven sash in deep maroon and mustard; Abdus Samad’s jama is warm ivory with a sparse pattern of tiny pale green and rust red floral sprigs, tied with a dark teal and gold woven sash; both jamas flare below the waist and overlap right over left, worn over slim churidar trousers in plain off-white that gather at the ankles; on their feet are soft tan leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes and minimal decoration; over one shoulder, each has a light cotton patka (stole) in muted patterns—Mir Sayyid Ali’s is soft grey with a thin maroon edge, Abdus Samad’s is pale yellow with a thin green edge—used to protect their clothes while painting.
appearance.signature: A single large, partially unrolled Hamzanama cotton folio held between them, painted side facing the viewer, with visible bold narrative scene outlines, mounted on a simple low wooden support frame; beside it, Mir Sayyid Ali grips a slender reed pen, and Abdus Samad lightly holds a thin, fine brush, both tools stained with pigment.

ref_desc: Two late-30s Mughal Persian master painters stand together, both in small white caps with cream turbans, one in a sky-blue striped jama with maroon sash and grey stole, the other in an ivory floral jama with teal sash and yellow stole, slim off-white churidar, tan mojari shoes, calmly holding a large partly unrolled Hamzanama cotton folio on a wooden frame while one carries a reed pen and the other a fine brush, using a sky blue, ivory, maroon, mustard and dark teal palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two Mughal court painters, Mir Sayyid Ali and Abdus Samad, standing side by side as a single character pair: both are lean men appearing late-30s to early-40s with light wheat-brown complexions, trimmed beards and moustaches, and observant, serious eyes; Mir Sayyid Ali has an oval face and gentler expression, Abdus Samad a slightly squarer jaw and more intense gaze. Both wear small white caps wrapped with narrow light-cream turbans, dark hair just visible at the temples. Mir Sayyid Ali is in a knee-length pale sky blue jama with very fine white vertical stripes and a subtle floral border at hem and cuffs, belted with a narrow maroon-and-mustard woven sash, over slim off-white churidar and tan leather mojari shoes; a soft grey cotton patka with a thin maroon edge is draped over one shoulder. Abdus Samad wears a knee-length warm ivory jama patterned with tiny pale green and rust red floral sprigs, tied with a dark teal and gold woven sash, over off-white churidar and matching tan mojari; a pale yellow patka with a thin green edge lies over his shoulder. Between them they support a large, partially unrolled Hamzanama cotton folio on a simple low wooden frame, the painted side facing the viewer with bold narrative outlines; Mir Sayyid Ali holds a slender reed pen stained with pigment, while Abdus Samad lightly holds a thin fine brush, all colours kept to a sky blue, ivory, maroon, mustard and dark teal palette, shown from multiple angles to capture face, hair, garments, footwear and their shared folio and tools clearly.
